Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
This card allows you to start a combat with an 'illusionary' vampire
before your vamp is about to enter combat.

Would pre-range and/or pre combat effects (like dawn operation for
instance) played before illusions of the kindred was played take
effect in the combat with this illusionary vamp?

T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. It's a different combat, and (for Dawn Op) it's not the "resulting"
combat. If the effect lasts for the whole action (like Uncontrollable
Rage), the it would apply, since it's still part of that action.
